Eatfit: Sumant
ThinkByte: Raghu Gorrela, Harsha Thota, vinay kovvuri, Charan, Bharath MVS
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on implementing AI-driven demand planning and enhancing data accessibility for a company managing over 400 cloud kitchens.
Attendees included Sumant from eatfit.in discussing requirements with Vinay, Raghu, and Harsha from thinkbyte.ai, who are developing solutions.
Key issues addressed were inefficient Excel-based demand planning, lack of ETL setup, and poor data visibility for non-technical staff.
Follow-up actions include signing an NDA, sharing demand planning documents, and setting up a meeting with the production team.
The team proposed developing a text-to-SQL tool to automate demand planning and improve data-driven decision-making.
